name: Prospective Listing Snapshot to Stable Instrument Candidate
principles: prospective listing evidence and stable instrument identity remain separate facts
automatic matching requires exact identifier equality and one active universe row with one valid ISIN
symbol normalization, name matching, suffix inference and venue inference are forbidden
the identity-match valid_from is the later of listing-snapshot valid_from and universe-observed-at
a listing snapshot may not create historical identity before both evidence inputs were project-known
duplicate current-master rows require review even when they share the same ISIN
an exact symbol match with multiple ISINs is ambiguous and fails closed
unmatched records remain unmatched; missing is not neutral
identity matching never implies historical universe membership, tradability or project investability
crypto and unsupported instrument classes are not auto-promoted by this matcher
